tft_lab_encounters.name: Cheaper Levels
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Each level costs 2 XP less.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Reroll Start
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Gain 8 free rerolls on 2-1.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Stage Three Augments
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Augments roll on 3-1, 3-2 and 3-3 instead of the usual rounds.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Artifact Anvil
tft_lab_encounters.effect: All players gain an Artifact Anvil on 3-3.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Double Duplicators
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Receive a Lesser Champion Duplicator immediately and another on 3-3.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Golden Gala
tft_lab_encounters.effect: All three augment rounds offer Gold-tier augments.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Prismatic Party
tft_lab_encounters.effect: All three augment rounds offer Prismatic-tier augments.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Prismatic Finale
tft_lab_encounters.effect: The last augment round is guaranteed Prismatic.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Prismatic Opener
tft_lab_encounters.effect: The first augment round is guaranteed Prismatic.

tft_lab_encounters.name: 3-cost Start
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Begin with a free 3-cost champion.

tft_lab_encounters.name: 2-cost Start
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Begin with a free 2-cost champion.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Upgraded Start
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Your starting champion arrives at 2-star.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Component Anvils
tft_lab_encounters.effect: PvE rounds drop Component Anvils in place of some component rewards.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Loot Subscription
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Steady stream of loot; 17.2 reduced both gold reward and Spatula odds.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Emblem Ensemble
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Receive a curated emblem at a fixed round.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Gold Subscription
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Bonus gold each turn for the duration of the subscription; 17.2 reduced the per-turn gold.

tft_lab_encounters.name: No Encounter
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Standard lobby; no opening encounter applied.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Howling Abyss
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Howling Abyss-themed encounter.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Silver Scrapes
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Combat-themed encounter.

tft_lab_encounters.name: Scouting Party
tft_lab_encounters.effect: Bench expanded so you can scout more shop options.

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 金金金之旅
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 带着三个黄金阶强化符文前去夺金！

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 彩彩彩之旅
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 莫甘娜将这局游戏的所有强化符文都变为棱彩阶。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 棱彩终章
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 格雷福斯将本局游戏的最后一个强化符文变为棱彩阶。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 棱彩前奏
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 慎的时间裂隙将本局游戏的第一个强化符文换成棱彩阶。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 3费开局
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 这局在开局时自带1个随机的3费弈子！

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 2费开局
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 这局在开局时自带1个随机的2费弈子！

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 2星开局
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 维克托将你的初始弈子升至2星。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 基础装备锻造器
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 获得2个【基础装备锻造器】。选择你的武器！

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 战利品订阅
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 塔姆每阶段从一个包罗万象的奖池中为你提供战利品！

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 纹章剧团
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 拉亚斯特用3个随机纹章开启你的旅程。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 金币订阅
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 佐伊在每个阶段开始时为你提供金币。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 没有奇遇
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 本局游戏不会出现奇遇。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 嚎哭深渊
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 获得5个随机的1费弈子组成的队伍。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 《Silver Scrapes》战歌响起
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 最终的两个玩家获得70金币，以迎接一场史诗级的决战。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 强化符文刷新
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 这局游戏获得+1强化符文刷新次数。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 双重复制器
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 获得一个【微型英雄复制器】。在3-5时，获得【次级英雄复制器】。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 神器锻造器
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 在阶段3-3时，所有玩家获得1个【神器锻造器】。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 更便宜的等级
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 娑娜使每一级所需的经验值减少2。

jcc_official_galaxy.name: 刷新开局
jcc_official_galaxy.desc: 在阶段2-1时，获得5次免费刷新。
